name: Quakebump
description: Lift the maul above the shoulder and let its head fall straight onto the target with both hands guiding.

name: Malletwedge
description: Push the level haft into the opponent's chest to rock them back off their footing.

name: Quake Drop
description: Swing the head flat and low in a wide arc that strikes across the shins.

name: Sledgeblow
description: Slide the upper hand down beside the head and chop short and quick at close range.

name: Solid Endcap
description: Hold the maul across the chest with both hands so an incoming blow lands on the haft.

name: Skipping Sledgeface
description: Let the swing of the maul pull the body around and step clear of the return blow.

name: Beetledrop
description: Swing the maul in a low pendulum arc from one hip to the other with both arms locked.

name: Dollybump
description: Bring the head up from below the knee into the underside of the opponent's guard.

name: Resting Gripbulge
description: Spread the hands far apart on the haft and knock a blow wide with the shaft.

name: Thudpace
description: Plant the rear foot hard as the head lands so the body stops and stays steady.

name: Downward Pommelweight
description: Drive the capped end of the haft straight forward into the soft belly of the opponent.

name: Single Wedgeface
description: Bring the full flat face of the head down on the target in one heavy stroke.

name: Malletstrike
description: Slide both hands to the lower haft and punch its end forward into the ribs.

name: Squash Husk
description: Snap the haft down on the opponent's wrists to loosen their grip on a weapon.

name: Sledgebump
description: Turn the maul end over end in the hands and strike with the opposite face.

name: Angled Maulbutt
description: Brace the haft against the hip and tilt the head up to take a cut on its side.

name: Quiet Flatten
description: Slip the grip along the haft while stepping inward to close or open the distance.

name: Beetlenote
description: Tap the poll against the ground ahead to feel for loose footing before advancing.

name: Dollyhit
description: Fall into the blow from the toes and bring the head down as if splitting a boulder.

name: Upward Heavyhelve
description: Crouch low with a wide stance and swing the head sideways at the knees.

name: Dollylid
description: Plant the head before the body and lean behind the haft to shelter from a thrust.

name: Descending Ironband
description: Let the head bounce up from a landed blow and bring it down again without a pause.

name: Stopping Mallethead
description: Scuff loose grit from the maul's landing point into the opponent's eyes to break their focus.

name: Shifting Thud
description: Drag the head back along the ground while stepping away to reset the grip.

name: Flat Pulverize
description: Throw the head over the crown and drop it along a straight line onto the target.

name: Open Quake
description: Lean the shoulders to one side as the head falls so the blow arrives from a slant.

name: Maulhead Dash
description: Whip the hips forward at the last moment so the head lands with added speed.

name: Resting Sledgeface
description: Lift the haft overhead and angle it so a descending cut slides off to the side.

name: Flatten Dodge
description: Arch the back to receive the maul's rebound and step the lead foot out of line.

name: Sharp Heavyhelve
description: Pour a thread of qi into the arms as the head falls to deepen the impact.

name: Gnawing Maulbutt
description: Hold the qi in the forearms through repeated short downstrokes that sink into one spot.

name: Angled Wedgeface
description: Send qi along the haft so it rings stiff and refuses to bend under a cut.

name: Hitching Pommelweight
description: Shove the flat head into the opponent's guard and release qi to throw them off their stance.

name: Maulhead Pace
description: Set the rear foot with a pulse of qi so the next blow starts from a firm base.

name: Beetleblow
description: Drag the head along the floor and whip it up into the opponent's ankle.

name: Ironband Review
description: Knock the poll on the ground and read the echo of qi through the haft for hidden hollows.

name: Sledgedash
description: Lower the head onto a guard from above with qi in the shoulders to crack it.

name: Warm Endcap
description: Hold a steady flow of qi in both shoulders so the maul feels lighter through a long fight.

name: Descending Squash
description: Let an enemy blade slide down the haft then answer with the head on the same line.

name: Settled Endcap
description: Sweep the whole maul across the body to bat an attack aside with its weight.

name: Pulverize Pace
description: Take two short steps with the maul held low and close the gap before the swing.

name: Quakecowl
description: Clip the opponent's weapon hand with the haft and a flick of qi to numb the fingers.

name: Planted Mallethead
description: Spread the feet and sink the hips so the maul's weight sits low and the body cannot be pushed.

name: Sideways Thud
description: Turn on the lead foot with the swing and bring the head around to face a new side.

name: Firm Sledge
description: Stamp the front foot as the head drops so body and weapon land together.

name: Turning Quake
description: Shift the weight and lift the head as if to strike high then drop low to the knees.

name: Mallethead Amble
description: Back away with the head trailing low so the maul never leaves the guard line.

name: Malletdrop
description: Carry the maul on the shoulder through a lunge and drop it forward as the leg lands.

name: Judging Maulhead
description: Breathe qi into the back and arms while raising the head so no strength is wasted between swings.

name: Endcapwedge
description: Cradle the maul across both forearms and turn the shoulder to meet an oncoming cut.

name: Narrow Pulverize
description: Heave the maul up and over like a heavy sack and let it fall with all the carried weight.

name: Sideways Squash
description: Walk forward under the maul's weight with staggered feet so a shove cannot topple the bearer.

name: Pushing Maulbutt
description: Drop the head onto the opponent's trailing foot or weapon tip and pin it to the ground.

name: Leaden Sledge
description: Turn the narrow splitting face forward and drive it into a seam of armor or timber.

name: Short Sledge
description: Swing the broad flat poll sideways against the head or shoulder to jar the opponent.

name: Calm Gripbulge
description: Press the wedge edge lightly against a guard and read through the haft where it is weakest.

name: Resting Ironband
description: Turn the broad poll outward and knock a thrust off line with a pulse of qi.

name: Beetledash
description: Flip the head mid-swing so the wedge face meets the target instead of the poll.

name: Quakeskitter
description: Shuffle forward with the poll held close to the chest to enter at an opponent's blind side.

name: Wide Thud
description: Alternate narrow wedge and flat poll blows in a steady rhythm with qi held in the wrists.
